text:
Marta Lopez: Heads-up — QuickCart wants a 2-week POC: streaming classifier (<200ms), nightly embeddings for search, and a tool-call to their price API. They asked for a 10M tokens/mo ballpark and SOC2/KMS bullets.

Ben Chu: Hosted is fine for POC. They may ask for a short-lived Dedicated pool if latency wins. Can we do ephemeral Dedicated?

Kaitlyn (Eng): Yes — we can provision a 48h-ready Dedicated trial (2 GPUs) for 2 weeks. Need signed trial terms + 48h lead. KMS supported; we'll need customer key ARN.

Marta Lopez: Security questionnaire inbound. Need canned answers: SOC2, retention, PII handling, encryption, IP allowlist.

sec-bot: Auto: SOC2 Type II available on NDA. Default log retention 30 days (contract-adjustable). Customer-managed KMS supported. PII redaction hooks available. VPC/VPN and IP allowlist for Dedicated/Private. Docs: https://redwood.example.com/security

Ben Chu: Integration — share tiny streaming + tool-call sample and deterministic schema they can map into ETL.

Ben Chu: ```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=\"<REDACTED>\")
with client.stream('classify', model='redwood-gen-3') as s:
    s.send({"text": "Item: \"Organic Gala Apple\"", "schema": "catalog_v1", "tool_calls": ["price_lookup"]})
    for chunk in s.iter_chunks():
        print(chunk.text)
```

Kaitlyn (Eng): Example final payload we emit (single final JSON event):

Ben Chu: ```json
{"product_id":"APL-GAL-01","category":"produce/apples","confidence":0.95,"tags":["organic"],"price":{"value":1.29,"currency":"USD","source":"price_lookup_v1"}}
```

Marta Lopez: Can we demo next Tue (stream -> tool-call -> S3 sink)? Need runbook + terraform snippet for short-lived IAM + IP ranges.

Kaitlyn (Eng): Yes. I'll draft runbook + TF snippet and a minimal sample repo. ETA: Friday EOD. Need QuickCart tech contact and IP ranges.

Ben Chu: I'll send a pricing ballpark tomorrow morning.

Marta Lopez: Thanks — I'll collect questionnaire answers and handoff. Keeping this thread as the coordination source. :white_check_mark:
